description: Resource Type definition for AWS::SageMaker::InferenceRouter. Creates a SageMaker Inference Router, a named entry point that routes inference requests for each routing target to one of its destination endpoints or inference components, which can be in other AWS Regions and accounts.

Destination.description: One placement of a routing target's model. ResourceArn is the destination's identity: changing it is a removal plus an addition.

ResourceArn.description: The ARN of a SageMaker endpoint or inference component that serves the routing target. It can be in any Region and account within the Inference Router's partition.
ResourceArn.markdownDescription:
The ARN of a SageMaker endpoint or inference component that serves the routing target. It can be in any Region and account within the Inference Router's partition.

---

Required: Yes  
Type: String  
Minimum Length: 20  
Maximum Length: 2048  
Pattern: ^arn:aws[a-z-]*:sagemaker:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:(endpoint|inference-component)/[a-zA-Z0-9](-*[a-zA-Z0-9]){0,62}$  
Update requires: No interruption

RoutingPreference.description: How the router prefers this routing target's destinations. LocalRegionFirst (the default) uses destinations in the router's Region first, then the others, each group in the order listed. InstancePoolOrder, for asynchronous routing targets only, tries destinations in order of the best instance pool they can serve from now. In both, degraded destinations are used after the others. If omitted, LocalRegionFirst is used and returned.
RoutingPreference.markdownDescription:
How the router prefers this routing target's destinations. LocalRegionFirst (the default) uses destinations in the router's Region first, then the others, each group in the order listed. InstancePoolOrder, for asynchronous routing targets only, tries destinations in order of the best instance pool they can serve from now. In both, degraded destinations are used after the others. If omitted, LocalRegionFirst is used and returned.
